title: Finite interval division without overflowing a reciprocal
observation: Interval(1e-310,1e-310) divided by itself raises ValueError even though its exact quotient is one.
cause: Constructing the standalone reciprocal overflows before multiplication by the small numerator.
change: Round the minimum and maximum of the four direct endpoint quotients outward. Keep zero-containing divisors and nonfinite enclosure endpoints rejected.
predicted_consequence: Finite subnormal ratios enclose their exact rational results; ordinary controls and prior rejection boundaries remain valid.
